metadata.description: Test model for the FPV Vehicle: after take-off, in acro mode, a 75 deg/s roll-rate step and its reversal. Assert blocks on the Tests sheet check that the roll rate settles on its setpoint, the overshoot is bounded, pitch and yaw stay quiet, and the quad returns level. The Vehicle block is a Model Reference to "FPV Vehicle" (npm run obliq:test -- "FPV Acro Rate Step").
